title: Jewel Toned Dutch Rice Pilaf
description: A malty and velvety Dutch dish featuring coconut milk, perfect for meal prep, and made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. This pilaf is a delicious and healthy option for any time of day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the turmeric, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the uncooked rice and stir to coat the rice with the oil and spice mixture.
Add the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the raisins.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
